newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-OWN GOAL SENDS RANGERS TO RARE LEAGUE DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OWN GOAL SENDS RANGERS TO RARE LEAGUE DEFEAT.

text.p: Rangers captain Richard Gough scored an own goal to present Dundee United with a 1-0 Scottish league win on Tuesday. In spite of the surprise defeat, Rangers remained eight points clear at the top. An error by goalkeeper Andy Goram led to the 66th minute winner, with the ball spinning off Gough's head after he misjudged a cross from Andy McLaren.
United substitute Neil Duffy was carried off then taken to hospital after a tackle by David Robertson.
